verdict.rationale: Quo documents voicemail transcription and lets users view voicemail transcripts from a chat client through its own MCP server and Claude/ChatGPT connectors, so a founder can read them without dialing in. That access is on demand (pull), not an automatic delivery of each new voicemail. Missing for 10: automatic push of new voicemail transcripts to email or a chat channel, any documented email delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server
